storyline.real: Prost leads in heavy rain; the race is stopped and the result taken from lap 31, Senna 7.4 s behind and closing

mastery.label: Ease off in the spray: no more than 14 laps at standard pace

hidden.label: Win by more than the real 7.4 seconds

eras.briefing: Monaco, June 1984. The start was delayed by heavy rain. Prost started on pole in the McLaren and leads; Senna started 13th in the Toleman and is closing fast. Turbo cars have 220 litres for the race. Pit boards only, no radio. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt from the results and race reports. Who led each lap is sourced; the lap times are reconstructed.
